download_mingw_with_cli: run the mingw CLI to download a specific MinGW version for a given architecture
fetch_repository_versions: fetch and parse the MinGW builds repository to list available compiler versions
unpack_archive_with_7zip: unpack a MinGW builds archive to a target directory using 7zip
find_7zip_on_system: find the 7zip executable on the system via PATH or Windows registry
locate_mingw_root: locate or download a specific MinGW variant and return its root directory path
